title: 2026 rookies
def: rookies: first NFL season (nflverse rookie flag). slot = overall pick. pre-draft FV fills from the draft ledger from the 2027 class on.
views: WAA this season: wins over an average regular at the sub-position, same snaps
WAR this season: .6 x AV WAR + .4 x XV
pXP/60: predictive points over an average regular per 60 snaps (a rookie has no past seasons, so this season alone, shrunk by K snaps to the sub-position mean moved by his draft slot)
XV: WAR on the stat-line parts that track team margin

SV (season value): this season's points over replacement a game, opponent-adjusted EPA (QBs: dropbacks + runs; skill: runs + targets; defenders: credited EPA on negative plays), as on the QBs / skill players / defenders tabs
SVAR: SV over replacement, season total, in wins: points / 36 a win

cols.t: wins over an average regular at the sub-position, same snaps

predictive points over an average regular at the sub-position per 60 snaps: this season shrunk by K snaps (QB 900, RB 450, WR 900, TE 300, DL 900, LB 1300, OL 2600, DB 3600) to the sub-position mean moved by his draft slot
points over an average regular at the sub-position per 60 snaps, this season (100+ snaps)
expected value: WAR from the stat line

SV (season value): this season's points over replacement a game, opponent-adjusted EPA (QBs: dropbacks + runs; skill: runs + targets; defenders: credited EPA on negative plays), as on the QBs / skill players / defenders tabs (QB, RB, WR, TE, DL, LB, DB)
SVAR: SV over replacement, season total, in wins: points / 36 a win

pre.t: overall pick in the draft (UDFA: undrafted)

pfv.t: CFB board FV on the eve of the draft (draft ledger, 2027 class on), mean outcome
